title: Dealer experience and local support
summary: Reviews discuss dealership interactions, with clear praise for helpful or excellent dealers, some complaints about poor support or unclear ownership of issues, and many fragments that are too brief or ambiguous to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise dealers as helpful, good, or excellent during purchase and support interactions.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe dissatisfaction with local dealers, weak problem ownership, and unhelpful communication.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention dealers or dealership handling but are often too short or unclear to assign a definite sentiment.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short or ambiguous, which limits confident interpretation.
The examples focus narrowly on dealer interactions and may not capture the full range of comments in the topic.
Some undetermined fragments contain language that hints at evaluation, but the provided labels prevent reassigning them to a clearer sentiment.
